response.likely_cause: The clinic experienced a software update issue that altered downstream referral thresholds and behavior, although image quality metrics like brightness (0.361 vs 0.373) and sharpness (0.000457 vs 0.000399) remained relatively stable.
evidence: Referral rate dropped significantly from 0.685 to 0.36, representing a relative change of -0.474.
Referral score mean decreased slightly from 0.193 to 0.188.
Image quality and sharpness did not drop sharply, with quality actually showing a slight increase from 0.5 to 0.529.
The evidence is weak regarding a pure population shift since software updates are explicitly noted as a factor and visual inspection shows possible processing anomalies.
recommended_checks: Verify the integrity and version of the recently deployed software update at the clinic.
Audit the decision threshold settings within the AI inference pipeline.
Review a random sample of recent scans manually to confirm actual disease prevalence versus model output.
